Welcome to Mt Buller Chalet Hotel & Suites
The Mt Buller Chalet Hotel & Suites is the perfect place to stay for the ultimate alpine experience. Stay in the heart of the village with breathtaking views of Bourke Street and the Delatite Valley.
In summer take an extended break and enjoy all that the area has to offer, from peaceful picnics on the summit and relaxing walks to the thrills of motorbiking, four-wheel driving and mountain biking all from right outside your door.
The hotel offers its guests an extensive range of facilities including: in-house bar and dining, spa, steam room and sauna, indoor heated swimming pool and gym.
Plan your
Mt Buller Holiday
Luxury Facilities at Mt Buller Chalet
The Chalet Hotel is open for summer stays on selected dates, with a range of facilities to enjoy during your stay including: spa, steam room and sauna, indoor heated swimming pool and gym. Guests enjoy complimentary wifi.
Summer biking facilities: Bike wash, bike rack, bike locks available, E-Bike charging, bike storage in rooms BYO drop sheets.
In winter the Mt Buller Chalet Hotel & Suites is home to a range of dining options. Try out the exclusive Black Cockatoo restaurant and the bustling Birdcage Bar & Restaurant.
The Black Cockatoo offers a shared and feed me inspired menu. Architecturally designed. Australian inspired.
Mt Buller’s new home for quality, Black Cockatoo is a raw mix of copper, leather, steel and charcoal paired with amazing views of Mt Stirling. Black Cockatoo serves wines from some of the best vineyards in the state, meticulously selected craft beers, and exciting new cocktails.
Birdcage offers up a modern selection of cafe fare, bringing that slice of Melbourne to Mt Buller.
All aspects are covered, from our La Marzocco coffee station to a lounge area, and everything in between, sets out to be a hub for all things food and drink.

Welcome to Mt Buller Chalet Hotel & Suites
The Mt Buller Chalet Hotel & Suites is the ideal winter alpine escape.
The 4-star hotel rests in the heart of the Mt Buller Village and is just steps away from the main chairlift. The hotel offers its guests an extensive range of facilities including: spa, steam room and sauna, indoor heated swimming pool and gym. Guests enjoy complimentary wifi.
The Chalet Hotel is also home to the Black Cockatoo restaurant and The Birdcage bar and restaurant. To make your alpine getaway even more relaxing, the Mt Buller Chalet Hotel has its own rental and retail store the Chalet Boutique open during the winter season.
Photos of rooms and views are indicative only and may vary depending on room allocated.
